prompt: A sticker chart has $5$ stickers in week $1$ and gains $7$ more stickers every week: $5, 12, 19, \dots$ How many stickers are on the chart in week $10$?
hint: From week $1$ to week $10$ is $9$ weeks of adding, not $10$.

hints.text: From week $1$ to week $10$ is $9$ weeks of adding, not $10$.
$9$ weeks of growth is $9 \times 7 = 63$ stickers added.

explanation: Week $1$ already has $5$ stickers, so the adding starts after that.
Getting from week $1$ to week $10$ takes $9$ steps: $9 \times 7 = 63$ stickers added.
Spot-check with the list: $5, 12, 19, 26, 33, 40, 47, 54, 61, 68$ — the 10th entry is indeed $68$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Just keep counting
steps: Count the entries — the tenth one is $68$.
